comments.text: From facet_pi security audit Finding 3 (Low): path_sanitizer.ex resolve_symlink_parts/3 recurses without a depth counter. A symlink loop would stack-overflow and disable ALL file tools. Catseye detects LongFunction (35 calls) but misses the actual recursion risk. Detection approach: flag recursive Elixir functions (function name appears in own body) that don't have a depth parameter or when clause guard. This is a code smell / security hygiene rule, similar to how Claws detects other patterns.

title: Elixir: detect unbounded recursion — recursive functions without depth guards
